## 🔬 Research Gaps Identified (Highlighted in Yellow in DOCX)

| # | Research Gap | Description |
|---|-------------|-------------|
| 1 | **No Standardized Reasoning Benchmarks** | No universal benchmark suite exists for evaluating reasoning quality, consistency, and robustness across different LLMs |
| 2 | **Limited Cross-Hardware Transferability** | Optimizations like FlashAttention-3 are tied to specific GPU architectures (NVIDIA Hopper); no hardware-agnostic frameworks exist |
| 3 | **Energy & Environmental Impact** | No standardized carbon footprint metrics or energy-efficient training paradigms for LLMs |
| 4 | **Safety of Emergent Reasoning** | No robust frameworks to ensure RL-emergent reasoning behaviors remain aligned, interpretable, and controllable |
| 5 | **Speculative Decoding Fragility** | Performance of speculative decoding under real-world workloads with varying conditions is insufficiently studied |
| 6 | **Multilingual Reasoning Gap** | Reasoning capabilities in low-resource languages are severely underexplored despite multilingual support |
